# Trovarcis Reach

> Email deliverability and number verification tools for anyone who sends email or verifies contacts. Six tools share one credit ledger: Email Scorer, Email Verifier, Number Verifier, Domain Checker, SMTP Tester, and DNS Record Generator. Three tools are free with no signup. New accounts get 10 free credits, no card required. Credits start at $5 with no minimum purchase and no subscription.

Trovarcis Reach is built for anyone who sends email, verifies contacts, or wants to. Business owners setting up email for a new company, founders running their own outreach, marketers checking domain health before a launch, cold outreach operators verifying lists, deliverability engineers diagnosing DMARC failures, SaaS teams verifying user signups at onboarding, and developers integrating email and number verification into their apps. Three of the six tools are free with no signup required (Domain Checker, SMTP Tester, DNS Record Generator), so a business owner can check whether a new domain is correctly configured for email without creating an account. The other three run on credits. Most verification services carry a minimum purchase of $30 to $50, which puts them out of reach for someone with a few hundred addresses to check. Trovarcis starts at $5. The blog covers foundational setup guides (SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, choosing a business email domain, first-time deliverability), technical deep-dives (RFC-level SPF debugging, Gmail Promotions classifier signals, blacklist delisting), and operational guides (list cleaning, bulk send safety, pricing model comparison).

## Tools

- [Email Scorer](https://trovarci.sh/score): Grades email content across five weighted categories using the Arcis engine: subject line, body content, structure, links, and compliance. Compliance checks CAN-SPAM requirements including unsubscribe mechanism and physical mailing address, plus GDPR and privacy-policy signals. Returns a score out of 100, a verdict, and the specific factors dragging placement with concrete fixes for each. 1 credit per scan, requires signup.
- [Email Verifier](https://trovarci.sh/verify): Single addresses or bulk lists up to 50,000 per job. Categorizes results as valid, invalid, catch-all, disposable, or role-based. Charges 1 credit per address and refunds every address that was not billable, meaning syntax failures, domains with no MX records, catch-all cache hits, and results the verification backend does not bill for. A badly decayed list therefore costs less to clean than a healthy one. 1 credit per address, single or bulk. Requires signup.
- [Number Verifier](https://trovarci.sh/verify-number): Phone number format validation against national numbering plans is free with no signup. Optional network lookup returns real carrier and line type (mobile, landline, VoIP, toll-free) for 2 credits per number, up to 10,000 per job. Useful for SMS campaign list cleaning, since landlines cannot receive SMS and fail silently, plus onboarding fraud prevention and voice outreach validation.
- [Domain Checker](https://trovarci.sh/domain): 25 checks across five categories: email authentication (SPF record and lookup count, SPF policy, DKIM selectors and key size, DMARC record, policy and reporting, BIMI), mail server (MX records, MX not CNAME, SMTP reachable, STARTTLS, reverse DNS), reputation (IP blacklists, domain blacklists, Safe Browsing), security (SSL certificate, HTTPS redirect, HSTS, CAA), and DNS configuration (nameserver redundancy and diversity, SOA, DNSSEC). Blacklist checks query 10 public DNSBL zones including Spamhaus ZEN and DBL, SpamCop, Barracuda, SORBS, UCEPROTECT, PSBL, Mailspike, blocklist.de, and SURBL. Free, no signup.
- [SMTP Tester](https://trovarci.sh/smtp-test): Diagnoses SMTP connection failures with plain-language explanations at every step of the handshake, including STARTTLS negotiation and reverse DNS. Shows exactly where a connection breaks and why. Free, no signup.
- [DNS Record Generator](https://trovarci.sh/records): Generates SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, BIMI, and MTA-STS records for any domain and any major email provider. Counts DNS lookups in real time and flags SPF records approaching the RFC 7208 10-lookup limit. Free, no signup.

## Guides

- [The complete guide to email deliverability in 2026](https://trovarci.sh/blog/email-deliverability-guide-2026): Broad overview of what determines inbox placement across Gmail, Outlook, and Yahoo. Covers authentication, reputation, the 2026 protocol layer (BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT), inbox placement classifiers, and infrastructure decisions. Start here if new to deliverability.
- [Why your emails go to spam (and how to find out which reason is yours)](https://trovarci.sh/blog/why-emails-go-to-spam): A diagnostic rather than a list. Separates the spam folder from the Promotions tab from outright rejection, then narrows the cause with four questions: all recipients or some, sudden or always, does authentication align, and is it the list or the message. Ranks the causes by how often each is actually the cause.
- [How to set up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC](https://trovarci.sh/blog/spf-dkim-dmarc-setup): Step-by-step configuration for the three email authentication protocols. Foundational setup for anyone connecting a new business domain to a mail provider.
- [Email domain health check: the 25 tests that matter](https://trovarci.sh/blog/email-domain-health-check): What a domain health check tests, what each failure costs in inbox placement, and which to fix first. Includes the case most guides skip: hardening a domain that sends no mail with null MX (RFC 7505) and `v=spf1 -all`, and the cross-domain DMARC reporting record that most checkers never verify.
- [Why your emails hit Gmail Promotions (and how to move them to Primary)](https://trovarci.sh/blog/gmail-promotions-tab-fix): The four signal groups Gmail uses to sort messages, why generic advice fails, and five concrete fixes ranked by impact. Covers subject-line patterns, HTML weight, List-Unsubscribe headers (RFC 8058), authentication baseline, and engagement warm-up.
- [SPF PermError: the 10 DNS lookup limit and how to fix it](https://trovarci.sh/blog/spf-permerror-10-dns-lookups-fix): RFC 7208 section 4.6.4 in plain language, how to count hidden lookups from nested includes, plus the void-lookup cap most articles miss. Three ranked fixes: prune stale includes, subdomain delegation, SPF flattening.
- [Is your domain blacklisted? How to check and fix it](https://trovarci.sh/blog/domain-blacklisted-check-fix): Diagnosing blacklist listings across major RBLs (Spamhaus, Barracuda, SORBS, and others) and the delisting process for each.
- [How to send bulk email without getting blacklisted](https://trovarci.sh/blog/send-bulk-email-without-blacklist): Blacklisting is caused by who you send to, not what you write. Covers the three kinds of spam trap (pristine, recycled, typo), bounce and complaint thresholds, volume shape, a six-step pre-send checklist, and a week-by-week ramp schedule.
- [How to clean an email list before sending](https://trovarci.sh/blog/clean-email-list-before-sending): What verification can determine and what it cannot. Includes an honest treatment of catch-all domains, where standard SMTP verification cannot resolve a mailbox because the server accepts everything, and what to do with each result category.
- [How to check phone numbers before sending bulk SMS](https://trovarci.sh/blog/check-phone-numbers-before-bulk-sms): Written for organizations with lists collected on paper, such as churches, schools, and shops. Covers why landlines fail silently, country code and format problems, the cost arithmetic of sending to dead numbers, and cleaning a hand-collected list.
- [What bulk email really costs](https://trovarci.sh/blog/bulk-email-cost): The four pricing models in email (per contact, per email sent, per message infrastructure, and owned software), real 2026 numbers at three list sizes, three-year totals, and where the money leaks on contact-based plans.
- [Trovarcis Reach vs SendBlaster](https://trovarci.sh/blog/trovarcis-reach-vs-sendblaster): Feature and pricing comparison for bulk email use cases.

## Company

- [Credits](https://trovarci.sh/credits): Flat $0.010 per credit at any volume, from $5. One credit is one US cent at every volume, so credits and cents are the same number. No monthly subscription and no minimum purchase. Credits expire 12 months from purchase.
- [Contact](https://trovarci.sh/contact): Contact form. Business inquiries: hello@trovarcis.com. Product support: support@trovarcis.com.
